channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: A Game About Needle In A Haystack
item.description: A first-person game about finding a needle in a giant haystack. Dig through the hay by hand, sell it at the cow, buy tools and upgrades in the workshop, and search the pile until you find the needle.

item.title: Beyond These Stars
item.description: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

item.title: Chillquarium
item.description: Chillquarium is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy fish and raise them in real time, then sell them to turn a profit! Customize your aquarium as you progress from a simple starter tank to your dream setup by filling your collection with rare exotic fish and ultra-rare color variants!

item.title: Devices Tycoon
item.description: Devices Tycoon is a unique business simulator that will make you feel like the owner of a company that creates your own devices! In the game you can create your own smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart watches, headphones, operating systems and even your own processors!

item.title: Dimenshot
item.description: Dimenshot is a melee-focused boomer shooter FPS set in distinct worlds, each representing one of the Seven Deadly Sins with its own unique theme. Melee combat is central, ranged weapons are supportive. Play fast and aggressive; combine parkour with combat.

item.title: Dreadline Express
item.description: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

item.title: Flipping is Hard
item.description: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff?

item.title: Futa Slug EX
item.description: NSFW roguelike with male/female player character creation, meta-progression, 55 collectible girls, and 9 epic boss battles! Step into the shoes of the Captain and dominate your lustful rivals. Supports all genitalia variations: hermaphrodite, male genitalia only, and female genitalia only.

item.title: Gotham Knights: Visionary Pack
item.description: Get the Visionary Pack to expand your cosmetic experience. The Visionary Pack includes the Exclusive ‘’Knightwatch by Jim Lee’’ Transmog, Beyond Suitstyle, Salvaging, Boosted Gear, 3 Suit Colorways, and an exclusive Emote.

item.title: Nordhold
item.description: Enemies are coming! Every decision matters: build your city, grow the economy, and prepare for enemy waves. Strengthen your defenses, adapt your strategy, and unleash your hero’s full potential. This unique Tower Defense will test your skills – are you worthy to claim a place at Valhalla?

item.title: Order: The New Dawn
item.description: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

item.title: Penguin Colony
item.description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

item.title: Tenebris Somnia
item.description: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares?

item.title: Tidy Up the Town
item.description: What have you done to the market?! Practising your amateur sorcery in the town square might not have been the best idea… You should really tidy up the market stalls before everyone arrives for a hard day’s work!

item.title: Watchmen: The End is Nigh
item.description: The lines between good and bad have been blurred and crime and terror run rampant in the streets. The alleys, rooftops and sewers are crawling with criminals and brutal gangs. And now, Underboss — in a daring escape — has broken out of prison and is ruling with vicious darkness.

item.title: Who's Cheating?
item.description: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for up to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

item.title: Stream Train
item.description: An online co-op horror game where up to 6 players livestream their trip down an abandoned rail road. Keep your audience entertained by filming creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Use chatter donations to buy fuel and gear. Can you make it through the Uncanny Valley alive?

item.title: Hay! One Billion!
item.description: You dropped your favorite needle... in a barn with exactly One Billion pieces of hay. Guess you better go find the needle in a haystack. Search around with your hands, find coins to purchase tools and search faster, and eventually reclaim your lost needle.

item.title: ATOM RPG - Plague Island
item.description: Plague Island is a story-driven DLC that expands the world of ATOM RPG with a new region, complete with its own characters, quests, and locations, as well as your very own suit of Special Armor.

item.title: DESOLUS
item.description: Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game. Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes. Travel through time to make structures whole and save the city from ruin.

item.title: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions Deluxe Pack
item.description: Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

item.title: LEGO® Worlds
item.description: Experience a galaxy of Worlds made entirely from LEGO bricks. EXPLORE gigantic landscapes, DISCOVER countless surprises, and CREATE anything you can imagine by building with LEGO bricks.

item.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Supporter Pack
item.description: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Supporter Pack delivers a bonus fan package with extra cosmetics for players who want to support the developer beyond buying the game itself.

item.title: Scribblenauts Unlimited
item.description: The best-selling, award-winning franchise is back – on your home PC in gorgeous HD for the first time.

item.title: Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping
item.description: A happy aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen! Tiny Aquarium is a social idle simulator that keeps growing, even when offline. Hatch, sell fish, decorate, go fishin’, and visit your friends’ aquariums with bite-sized daily sessions.

item.title: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator
item.description: Create dream homes! From 3D plan modelling through to on-site decision-making, you must bring each project to life while giving free rein to your creativity, to take your architectural firm to the pinnacle of the profession.

item.title: Back 4 Blood
item.description: Back 4 Blood is a thrilling cooperative first-person shooter from the creators of the critically acclaimed Left 4 Dead franchise. Experience the intense 4 player co-op narrative campaign, competitive multiplayer as human or Ridden, and frenetic gameplay that keeps you in the action.

item.title: Chained Beasts
item.description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

item.title: F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin
item.description: Assume the role of Special Forces Sgt. Becket as your routine mission quickly turns into a fight for survival against the wrath of Alma Wade. As Alma's terrifying power surges out of control, your squad is forced to battle through an apocalyptic landscape in search of clues for how to destroy her!

item.title: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
item.description: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends. Supports up to 16 players in online co-op.

item.title: Gauntlet™ Slayer Edition
item.description: The classic Gauntlet 4-player co-op action gameplay returns in a completely new experience! Battle the endless hordes of foes as you and your friends fight for treasure and glory via both local and online co-op multiplayer. Invade the Darkness!

item.title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition
item.description: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition enhances the bold new franchise to the fighting game genre from NetherRealm Studios. Featuring six new playable characters, over 30 new skins, and 60 new S.T.A.R. Labs missions, this edition packs a punch.

item.title: Mad Max
item.description: Play as Mad Max, a reluctant hero and survivor who wants nothing more than to leave the madness behind and find solace.

item.title: Odd Town
item.description: Odd Town is a story-driven first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized town, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, dodge cops, become a conspiracy theorist, and steal sandwiches.

item.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check - Miami Supporter Pack
item.description: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Miami Supporter Pack delivers a bonus fan package with extra cosmetics for players who want to support the developer beyond buying the game itself.

item.title: Scam With Your Friends
item.description: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.

item.title: Unity of Command II
item.description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

item.title: World of Goo 2
item.description: Build bridges, grow towers, terraform terrain, and fuel flying machines in the stunning followup to the multi-award winning World of Goo. The world is beautiful, dangerous, and evolving.

item.title: Voidtrain - Big Catch
item.description: Catch fish aboard your train, upgrade your gear, and earn Scales with every catch to spend on fishing upgrades and train decor.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!
